falseFriends.actual: Use 'الفعلي' (al-fi'li = real/measured), NOT 'الحالي' (al-hali = current/present). 'Actual output' = 'الإنتاج الفعلي'.
falseFriends.performance: Use 'الأداء' (al-ada') for the OEE performance component. NOT 'بيرفورمانس' (informal English loanword) or 'الأداء العام' (over-expanded).
falseFriends.quality: Use 'الجودة' (al-jawda) for the OEE quality rate metric. NOT 'النوعية' (al-naw'iyya = type/grade) or 'الكيفية' (al-kayfiyya = qualitative).
falseFriends.availability: Use 'التوافر' (al-tawafur) for OEE availability component. NOT 'الإتاحة' (al-itaha = IT/resource accessibility).
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'الهالك' (al-halik = manufacturing waste/scrap) or 'المرفوضات' (al-marfudat = rejected units). NOT 'الخردة' (al-khurda = junk/scrap metal for recycling).
falseFriends.stop: Use 'توقف' (tawaqquf) for production stop event; 'وقت التوقف' (waqt al-tawaqquf) for downtime duration. NOT 'التعطل' (al-ta'attal = breakdown/malfunction — implies unplanned only).
falseFriends.shift: Use 'الوردية' (al-wardiyya) for modern manufacturing MSA. NOT 'النوبة' (al-nawba = archaic/classical Arabic).
falseFriends.line: Use 'خط الإنتاج' (khatt al-intaj = production line) with qualifier. NOT bare 'خط' (khatt = line, phone line, text line — ambiguous).

grammarNotes.rtlScript: RTL Arabic script; Latin acronyms (OEE, KPI, MTTR, MTBF, SPC, TPM) maintain LTR directionality via Unicode BiDi. Formula displays (e.g., 'OEE = التوافر × الأداء × الجودة') may need explicit dir="ltr" wrapping for the formula part.
grammarNotes.definiteArticle: The Arabic definite article 'ال' (al-) prefixes directly to nouns. Sun letters (14) cause phonological assimilation in pronunciation but spelling always retains 'ال'. Example: 'التوافر' (al-tawafur) — NOT 'اتوافر'. No tashkeel on 'ال' in professional text.
grammarNotes.idafaConstructState: Compound nouns via iḍāfah construct state: first noun (muḍāf) + second noun (muḍāf ilayhi in genitive with 'ال'). Examples: 'سبب التوقف' (stop reason), 'زمن الدورة' (cycle time), 'خط الإنتاج' (production line), 'نموذج الوردية' (shift template). Only the final element takes full definiteness marking.
grammarNotes.dualAndCompoundPluralization: Arabic has three numbers: singular, dual, plural. In iḍāfah compounds, ONLY the head noun (muḍāf) pluralizes; modifier (muḍāf ilayhi) stays genitive singular. 'سبب التوقف' (sg.) → 'أسباب التوقف' (pl.) — NOT 'أسباب التوقفات' (over-pluralized modifier). 'أسباب' is a broken plural of 'سبب'.
grammarNotes.noTashkeel: Arabic professional B2B text must NOT contain tashkeel (vowel diacritics ُ ِ َ ّ etc.), except in the rare case where a word is genuinely ambiguous without them [Microsoft Arabic Style Guide §4.1.7]. Diacritics otherwise appear only in Quran, children's books, and language learning materials. Adding tashkeel to manufacturing software UI is patronizing.
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Use Western Arabic numerals (0–9), NOT Eastern Arabic-Indic (٠–٩) — Microsoft's standard rule, confirmed across GCC enterprise software [MS §4.1.12]. Decimal: period (.). Percentage: '85%' (no space). Thousands: comma (1,000). Count-agreement rule [MS §4.1.12]: 0 is NOT written as a digit — render as 'لا يوجد' / 'لا توجد' (none); 1 is spelled out (واحد / واحدة); 2 uses the dual form (e.g., 'توقفان' for 2 stops, 'ماكينتان' for 2 machines); 3 and above use digits normally. Critical for manufacturing dashboards showing counts like '0 stops today', '1 changeover', '2 machines down'.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE (Latin acronym) is universally used in Arabic-language manufacturing contexts. No Arabic-letter OEE acronym exists. Most common Arabic descriptive expansion: 'فعالية المعدات الشاملة' (fa'aliyyat al-mu'iddat al-shamila). Alternatives in use: 'الكفاءة الإجمالية للمعدات', 'الكفاءة الكلية للماكينات'. For UI: use 'OEE'. For tooltips/documentation: 'OEE (فعالية المعدات الشاملة)'.

usagePattern.documentation: OEE (فعالية المعدات الشاملة) on first mention

commonMistakes: Using 'الحالي' instead of 'الفعلي' for 'actual' — الحالي means 'current/present' (temporal), not 'real/measured'
Using 'الخردة' instead of 'الهالك' for 'scrap' — الخردة means recycling/junk metal, not manufacturing defect tracking
Over-pluralizing iḍāfah modifier: 'أسباب التوقفات' (wrong) → 'أسباب التوقف' (correct) — only the head noun pluralizes
Using 'النوعية' instead of 'الجودة' for the OEE quality rate metric — النوعية means type/grade, not the OEE quality component
Using 'التعطل' for all production stops — التعطل implies unplanned breakdown only; use 'التوقف' for all stop categories including planned
Adding tashkeel (vowel marks) to manufacturing UI text — diacritics are inappropriate in B2B professional software

Using digits for 0/1/2 in Arabic UI counts — Microsoft §4.1.12 specifies: 0 renders as 'لا يوجد' (none), 1 as 'واحد', 2 in the dual form (e.g., 'ماكينتان' for 2 machines); dashboards displaying '0 stops' or '2 alerts' with literal digits read unnaturally in MSA
notes: OEE (Latin) universally used in Arabic manufacturing (english_dominant, high confidence). MSA is mandatory; regional dialects strictly excluded. Length multiplier 2.0 validated against 73 real glossary-term pairs in terms.json (2026-04-22): mean=0.97, median=1.00, p95=1.38, max=1.56; FP rate at multiplier=2.0 is 0.00%. Value is conservatively over-provisioned — tightening to 1.7 would still yield 0% FP. Kept at 2.0 for margin against future additions. Prior calibration from 1039 locale pairs (mean=1.07, p95=1.71) showed slightly higher ratios because UI strings include short English words that require multi-word Arabic phrases; glossary terms are more compact. RTL handling uses Unicode BiDi. Western Arabic numerals (0–9). ConsistencyValidator now passes for Arabic at 100% coverage.
